MK Stalin urges DMK cadres to prepare for early elections

Tamil Nadu's former Chief Minister MK Stalin has alerted DMK cadres to be ready for potential early elections, stating that elections can occur at any time. He described the current state of Tamil Nadu as a 'deep mess' within a month of the new regime, citing issues like industrial reluctance, rising crime, and farmer distress. His son, Udhayanidhi Stalin, also criticized the current government's performance.
